Description: Ranking of the crop combination by its best provisional score. Rank 1 is highest.
The three crops included in the combination, stored alphabetically and regardless of planting order.
Highest provisional screening score among the alternative sequences for this crop combination. Not a yield prediction or probability.
Alternative orders for the three crops, separated by semicolons.
Number of alternative rotation sequences grouped under this crop combination.
Legume crop or crops included in the combination.
Botanical family order for the first listed alternative sequence only.
Combination-level explanation. The score evaluates average crop-level characteristics, not planting-order effects.
Ranking of an individual ordered rotation in the detailed rotation output.
The individual three-crop sequence in its listed order.
Provisional weighted screening score from 0 to 100, calculated using the average crop-level component scores.
Average normalized GAEZ favourable suitability score for the three crops.
Average normalized GAEZ very suitable extent score for the three crops.
Average provisional heat-tolerance category score, normalized to 0–100.
Average provisional water-demand score, where lower water-demand categories receive higher screening scores.
Indicates that irrigation availability should be assessed before considering cultivation.
Indicates that local planting-calendar validation is required.
